label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user input from request.getParameter). Although the code checks param.matches(pat) before writing, this is a validation check, not an encoding transformation. Direct reflection of user input to the response body without HTML encoding constitutes an XSS vulnerability, especially since the allowlist pattern 'pat' is not verified to exclude all malicious payloads. Steps 2-3 confirm attacker-controlled data reaches the sink expression.

evidence.note: User input 'param' retrieved from request and printed to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding.
